project.title: Launch of New Medical Device Education & Sales Program
project.objective: Design and roll out a coordinated education-driven sales program for a new medical device across key healthcare accounts.
deliverables: Segmented target account list with priority tiers
Educational slide deck and product training materials for clinicians
Standardised sales call script and objection-handling guide
Digital outreach plan for social media and email campaigns
KPI dashboard template for tracking leads, demos and orders
constraints: All materials must comply with medical device promotion regulations
No off-label claims or unapproved indications in any content
Initial pilot must be ready within 21 days
Use only approved clinical data and references
Budget limits in-person events to existing key accounts
All customer interactions must be logged in the CRM

risks.risk: Educational content or sales scripts breach promotional regulations.
risks.mitigation: Have regulatory and medical affairs review and approve all materials before use.

risks.risk: Healthcare professionals show low engagement with the new program.
risks.mitigation: Pilot with a small group of receptive accounts, gather feedback, and refine messaging and format.

risks.risk: Sales team adoption of new scripts and tracking is inconsistent.
risks.mitigation: Run short mandatory training, share quick-reference guides, and monitor CRM usage weekly.

risks.risk: Delays in obtaining final clinical data and claims for the device.
risks.mitigation: Prepare draft materials with placeholders and lock timelines with medical affairs early.

themes.why_relevant: All sales and education content must respect medical device promotion rules.
Program relies on clinical education to drive adoption rather than pure price selling.
Focusing on the right hospitals and clinics is key to early traction.
Common scripts, tracking and KPIs enable consistent execution and measurement.
Sales and education roles must align on content, events and feedback loops.

backlog.task: Define and prioritise target healthcare accounts for the new device pilot
definition_of_done: Target list grouped by region and specialty is created in shared sheet
Each account assigned a priority tier and owner
List reviewed and agreed by all medical sales representatives

backlog.task: Draft clinician-focused educational slide deck on the new device
definition_of_done: Slide deck covers indications, mechanism, benefits and safety information
All clinical claims sourced and referenced
Deck submitted for regulatory and medical affairs review

backlog.task: Create standardised sales call script and objection-handling guide
definition_of_done: Script includes opening, needs assessment, key messages and closing
Top 10 common objections with compliant responses documented
Guide approved by regulatory affairs specialist

backlog.task: Design digital outreach plan using social media and email for HCPs
definition_of_done: Channels, frequency and content themes defined in a brief
Sample posts and email templates drafted
Plan validated by marketing manager and regulatory affairs specialist

backlog.task: Prepare quick-reference product sheet for sales visits
definition_of_done: One-page sheet summarises key features, benefits and contraindications
No off-label statements included
Final PDF uploaded to shared drive and linked in channel

backlog.task: Set up KPI tracking template for leads, demos and orders
definition_of_done: Spreadsheet includes fields for account, stage, value and next step
Definitions of each KPI documented in first tab
Template shared and walkthrough provided to sales team

backlog.task: Plan and schedule pilot educational webinars for key accounts
definition_of_done: List of 3–5 pilot webinars with topics and target accounts created
Tentative dates and presenters confirmed
Invitations templates prepared and shared with sales team

backlog.task: Collect and consolidate feedback from initial sales calls and visits
definition_of_done: Feedback from at least 10 sales interactions logged
Common questions and concerns summarised
Summary shared in channel and used to update scripts if needed

backlog.task: Develop internal training session for sales team on new program
definition_of_done: Training agenda and slides prepared
Session scheduled and communicated to all medical sales representatives
Recording or notes shared after the session

backlog.task: Align on CRM fields and process for logging new device activities
definition_of_done: Required CRM fields for the new device documented
Example entries created as reference
Team agreement on logging process captured in channel

backlog.task: Compile post-pilot performance and lessons learned report
definition_of_done: KPI data from pilot period collected in tracking sheet
Key insights and improvement actions summarised
Report shared with stakeholders before final rollout decision

backlog.task: Refine messaging and materials based on regulatory feedback
definition_of_done: All requested changes from regulatory review implemented
Updated versions of scripts and sheets uploaded
Change log posted in channel for visibility

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on target account list and pilot scope for the new device program.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and asking for input on target accounts.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the initial list of pilot accounts and priority tiers in A1.
Confirm the number of accounts to include in the first pilot wave.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review and finalise educational slide deck and sales script.
threads_plan.trigger: Assistant lecturer shares first draft of deck and asks for sales feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final structure and key messages of the educational slide deck.
Approve the standard sales script and objection-handling guide for use in the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock the digital outreach plan and webinar schedule.
threads_plan.trigger: Proposal of draft digital outreach plan and webinar topics for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which digital channels and content types to use in the pilot.
Confirm dates and target accounts for the first webinars.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on CRM logging, KPIs and reporting expectations.
threads_plan.trigger: Message sharing KPI tracking template and CRM process draft.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final KPI set and definitions for the pilot.
Confirm the CRM logging process and minimum data to capture per interaction.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Share pilot results, feedback and decide on broader rollout.
threads_plan.trigger: Post-pilot message summarising early numbers and linking to the report draft.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Reconfirm or adjust target account strategy based on pilot learnings.
Decide whether to keep or update the sales script for full rollout.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async check-in where each participant posts top 3 priorities and blockers for the program.
Weekly summary message with pilot KPIs, key feedback and any changes to scripts or materials.
Pre-webinar coordination thread 24 hours before each event to confirm roles, materials and follow-up plan.
Post-call debrief posts where reps share notable questions or objections from clinicians.
